overall_notes: The paper focuses on adapting sentence-level metrics for document-level text simplification evaluation. It benchmarks multiple automatic metrics and uses both human evaluations and LLM-as-judge approaches. The extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant information and model variants that needed consolidation.
